proposed_widenings.name: Effect.half_damage
proposed_widenings.justification: Circle of Death (and all save-for-half-damage spells) deal exactly half the fail damage on a successful save. The current Effect type has no variant to express this derived relationship. The success branch must be encoded as an independent DiceAmount (4d8 + 1d8/slot), which is numerically correct but loses the invariant that success = fail / 2. A half_damage variant on Effect (or a halfDamageOnSuccess boolean on save_gate) would capture this without duplicating the scaling chain.
proposed_widenings.evidence: taking 8d8 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one

notes: Spell encodes cleanly and typechecks. The trace is numerically accurate (8d8 fail / 4d8 success with correct slot scaling). The surface_widening is narrow: only the 'half of fail' relationship is inexpressible, not the values themselves. The workaround (two independent DiceAmounts) produces a correct graph but duplicates the scale_die_count node. The branches_on_save relation is used for both fail and success paths with no label distinction — this is an existing limitation of the surface, not new pressure from this unit.
